findings.evidence: `pkg/statistics/handle/ddl/subscriber.go:245` calls `storage.UpdateStatsVersion` for `ActionFlashbackCluster`; `pkg/statistics/handle/storage/update.go:35` updates `mysql.stats_meta.version` (plus `stats_extended`/`stats_histograms`) but does not update `mysql.stats_meta.last_stats_histograms_version`; `pkg/statistics/handle/cache/statscache.go:209` reuses cached table stats (skips `TableStatsFromStorage`) when `oldTbl.LastStatsHistVersion >= last_stats_histograms_version`; `pkg/statistics/handle/storage/read.go:504` shows `TableStatsFromStorage` is the code path that reloads column/index stats from `mysql.stats_histograms`.
findings.fix: Update `storage.UpdateStatsVersion` to also bump `mysql.stats_meta.last_stats_histograms_version` (e.g. `UPDATE mysql.stats_meta SET version=%?, last_stats_histograms_version=%?`), so FlashbackCluster forces the background worker to reload column/index stats instead of taking the reuse fast-path. Optionally tighten the reuse predicate in `StatsCacheImpl.Update` to avoid reusing when the stored hist version can move backward (e.g. FlashbackCluster) by requiring equality instead of `>=`.
findings.impact: After `FLASHBACK CLUSTER`, the stats tables (including `mysql.stats_meta.last_stats_histograms_version`) can rewind to an older/non-null value, but `UpdateStatsVersion` only bumps `stats_meta.version`. With the new reuse optimization, the stats cache update worker may treat column/index stats as “unchanged” and keep pre-flashback histograms/topn/buckets in memory, leaving stale/inconsistent statistics and potentially severe plan regressions after flashback.
findings.verify: Execute `FLASHBACK CLUSTER` on a cluster where `mysql.stats_meta.last_stats_histograms_version` is non-NULL for some user tables, then ensure `StatsCacheImpl.Update` reloads full table stats (hits `TableStatsFromStorage`) and that `last_stats_histograms_version` is bumped along with `version`; validate by observing `statsHandle.GetTableStats(tableInfo).LastStatsHistVersion` changes and that refreshed histogram versions match storage.
findings.what: FlashbackCluster stats refresh can become incomplete: `storage.UpdateStatsVersion()` doesn’t update `last_stats_histograms_version`, so the new background stats update worker may reuse cached column/index stats and skip reloading histograms after `FLASHBACK CLUSTER`.

subject: statistics: speed up the backgroud stats update worker (#58490)
summary: This commit adds `mysql.stats_meta.last_stats_histograms_version` and uses it in the stats cache update worker to reuse cached column/index stats when only meta changes, plus updates bootstrap and stats write/GC/DDL paths to maintain the new column. A High-severity gap remains for `FLASHBACK CLUSTER`: the trigger path (`storage.UpdateStatsVersion`) doesn’t bump `last_stats_histograms_version`, so the new reuse fast-path can preserve stale histogram stats after flashback.
